description: This file defines the SimpleGeofence class, representing a geofence with properties like ID, location, radius, expiration, and transition type. It provides methods to access these properties and convert the custom object into a Google Play Services Geofence object.

classes.name: SimpleGeofence
classes.description: Represents a geographic fencing zone with properties such as location, radius, transition types, and expiration. Provides method to convert to Google Play Services Geofence.

methods.name: SimpleGeofence
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all properties of the geofence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the geofence.

methods.name: getLatitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude of the geofence center.

methods.name: getLongitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude of the geofence center.

methods.name: getRadius
methods.description: Returns the radius of the geofence.

methods.name: getExpirationDuration
methods.description: Returns the expiration duration of the geofence.

methods.name: getTransitionType
methods.description: Returns the transition type of the geofence.

methods.name: toGeofence
methods.description: Creates and returns a Google Geofence object from this SimpleGeofence.
